questions.question: What is the key difference between AOT and JIT compilation?
options: AOT compiles templates to JavaScript during the build; JIT ships the compiler to the browser and compiles templates at runtime
JIT is only used in production builds
AOT is slower to start up than JIT
There is no real difference, just different names for the same process
questions.explanation: AOT does the template-to-JS compilation ahead of time at build, avoiding the need to ship the compiler itself or compile in the browser.

questions.question: What is one practical benefit of AOT catching template errors at build time instead of JIT catching them at runtime?
options: A broken binding fails the build instead of shipping a runtime error to real users
AOT makes templates render with different HTML
AOT removes the need for component classes
questions.explanation: Since AOT compiles templates ahead of time, a typo in a binding surfaces as a build failure the developer sees immediately, rather than a runtime bug users encounter.

questions.question: What is the purpose of having both `environment.ts` and `environment.prod.ts`?
options: They are both required and loaded together at runtime
The CLI's fileReplacements swaps one for the other at build time, so the same code can point at different config (like API URLs) per environment
They control which browser the app supports
They are unused legacy files from older Angular versions
questions.explanation: Using fileReplacements, the production build configuration substitutes environment.prod.ts in place of environment.ts, swapping config values without branching logic in the app code.

questions.question: What does a bundle budget in angular.json do?
options: Limits how many components a project can have
Warns or fails the build if the output JavaScript exceeds a configured size threshold
Sets a maximum number of HTTP requests per page
questions.explanation: Budgets act as a build-time guardrail against bundle size regressions, failing or warning once the output exceeds the configured thresholds.
